updates.evidence: Frozen worlds now distinguish source-head evaluation from integration-result evaluation and separately bind frozen source/base, platform integration revision/tree and actually executed revision/tree.
updates.implementation: FrozenSubjectSpec + PlatformSubjectObservation + ExecutionSubjectObservation + verify_execution_subject; fail-closed INVALID/CANNOT_CHECK plus explicit tree-only partial identification.
updates.remaining_gap: The trusted-parent workflow does not yet produce these typed observations, so this module is supporting infrastructure rather than active promotion authority. Activation requires a separate frozen workflow benchmark.

updates.problem: A verified tree/content state and a verified revision/history object support different downstream claims. RAKL lacks a registry that says which identity scope is sufficient for each validator or promotion claim.
updates.target: Add claim-scoped authority requirements so tree-only evidence can authorize content-state claims without authorizing exact-revision/reproducibility claims.
required_known_answer_worlds: same tree under different commits is sufficient for a content-only deterministic function but insufficient for revision provenance
same revision label with mismatching executed tree is invalid
tree-only partial identification remains visible through downstream synthesis
validator explicitly requiring revision identity rejects tree-only evidence

updates.problem: The current test workflow references actions by major tags. The round-008 execution log resolved those tags to concrete action commits at runtime, so unchanged workflow text does not freeze the evaluator's transitive action implementation identity.
updates.target: Freeze/attest evaluator dependencies and runtime resolution, preferably with immutable action SHAs or externally observed resolved digests, without confusing dependency provenance with test correctness.
required_known_answer_worlds: same workflow text with a moved action tag is detected as evaluator-identity drift
full-length pinned action commits yield stable action identity
runner/toolchain image drift is surfaced separately from repository evaluator code drift
dependency attestation with missing or candidate-self-reported resolution returns CANNOT_CHECK
legitimate dependency upgrade requires a new frozen evaluator benchmark rather than silent inheritance

updates.note: Round 008 reinforces that subject identity requires external evidence, but does not solve authority ranking for dataset/content identity assertions.
Exact claim-to-evidence spans remain the highest-value scientific provenance target after execution/evaluator identity is stabilized.
